title: Gillibrand and Rubio's push for accountability over rogue programs

tellings.quote: first order the interest of the Gillibbrands and the Rubios etc. for the last several years has not really been disclosure, it's been accountability. Yeah. It's finding out that there's rogue programs that they had no idea it were in existence that were controlling groundbreaking world shaking information.

plain: For several years, from about 2019, Senators Kirsten Gillibrand and Marco Rubio have really been after accountability, not disclosure, according to the researcher Matthew Pines. He tells Michels, without naming a source, that what drives them is finding out that 'rogue programs' they never knew existed were 'controlling groundbreaking world shaking information'. If that is right, the push in the Senate is about who controls secret programmes, more than about revealing what they hold.
